_doc: Cloud Dialer self-contained offline spam list. Grounded in the FOSS call-blocker model (SpamBlocker aj3423, Yet Another Call Blocker xynngh): each rule matches an incoming number by exact value, dialling prefix, or regex. Fully offline — no network, no server. The in-app updater (GHCR/WorkManager) ships newer versions of this asset with app updates. Keep entries conservative: false positives silently reject real calls. Numbers are E.164-ish (leading +, digits only after normalisation). Categories surface in the screened-call history and the in-call spam warning.
